scope: One fused JPEG inverse-certificate magnitude primitive, two native-input repeats and one affected owned-input screen. Two frozen JPEGs use one existing original 513x259 raster. No new image, preparation or quality enumeration.
changedPrimitive: Reuse each exact dequantized sample for four independent magnitude sums inside the horizontal pass. Their integer reduction produces the identical M and E. No separate 64-term serial pass or repeated dequantization. Extreme blocks discard horizontal sums before writing and retain the original direct evaluation; uncertain rows, AVX/scalar and logical admission remain unchanged. No FMA, new table, buffer, cache, dependency or unsafe code.

baseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

provenance: Frozen prepared native qscale-5 JPEG from HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8), original deterministic asymmetric RGBA8 flattened once on RGB 0x204060. 133041 bytes, common 1x2 factors (4:4:4) and variable Huffman tables. No additional source raster, upstream corpus or quality enumeration.
preliminaryScope: One eight-accumulator screen, no repeat. Generated code spilled two scalar sums; the same primitive was refined to four independent exact sums before the final repeats. No new image or quality preparation.

currentCpuProfile.scope: Separate current fused-magnitude NativeDecode8 warm JPEG CPU sampling; workload loops include warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.
currentCpuProfile.attributionRule: Match method names before the first parenthesis; parameter type names are excluded. coefficientEntropyGroup is the union of coefficient, reader and Huffman methods, not one primitive.

profileAssemblyControls.scope: Built profile project assembly; BenchmarkDotNet removed its child build directory during cleanup. Source inventory and the completed child build log accompany the trace.

uncertainty: Short screens guide ranking and do not certify uniform parity. Ratios use the faster native bracket. Conservative uppers retain managed and native sample uncertainty; a nonpositive denominator is unbounded. The owned input has one affected screen. Failed post-run quiet samples and later passing cooldowns are retained.
